name: Tempester n°29: the 8 beat-wide positions over MIDI both ways (CC 20-27 + LSB CC 52-59), reported after any panel action
explanation: Dependency: requires n°9b (patch/nrpn_emission.json) for its SENDCC routine at 0x9d07a504. Bug: in 16 Beats and 16 Mutes (Pad Function mode 0 and 4, [routine]) the panel knobs act on the whole beat (absolute controls 0, 1, 3, 4, 5 -> [routine] [address]; encoders 1, 6, 7 -> [routine]) without knob_edit, so nothing is sent and the app cannot follow. The beat-wide state is 22 u16 positions at [address] (0-254, neutral 0x7F); the stock OS already receives 8 of them as CC 20-27 ([routine] [address]: position = 2 x value, no mode test, Remote Pad IN channel): 20 All Osc Freq (index 0x13), 21 Feedback (4), 22 LP Freq (5), 23 Resonance (6), 24 Audio Mod (7), 25 HP Freq (8), 26 Attack (0x14), 27 Decay (0x15). Fix, same bytes both ways (14-bit MIDI convention, CC 52-59 = LSB of CC 20-27): position p is sent as CC 20+i = p >> 1, then CC 52+i = 0x40 only when p is odd; a received CC 52+i sets the position to (p & ~1) | (value >> 6 & 1), clamped to 254, through [routine](beat, p, index, 1) as [routine]. (1) The four panel event publishers [routine] (keys), [routine] (encoders), [routine] (absolute controls) and [routine] (sliders), reached only from [routine], the key-hold tick [routine] and n°21 / n°23 (main loop), end with j [routine]: WRAP (0x9d07d434) copies the 8 positions, makes the call and raises one pending bit per changed position. (2) A position set by CC 20-27 or CC 52-59 is not reported (no echo); a move by the remote panel (n°21 keys, n°23 NRPN 200-229) is, as n°9b and n°22 do for those. (3) DRAIN (0x9d07d4a8), in place of the two main-loop calls of [routine] (made by DRAIN as a tail call): a beat change ([address] differs from the copy in [address]) raises all 8 bits; then if bits are pending, Remote Pad OUT is not Off and the DIN send ring holds at most 16 bytes, every pending position is sent (at most 48 bytes) through SENDCC (DIN then USB) and the bits are cleared; Off: nothing sent, bits kept. (4) RX (0x9d07d57c), in [routine]'s CC handler after its Remote Pad IN test: CC 52-59 set the low bit; CC 107 (n°22's full-state request) also raises the 8 bits; every other CC is unchanged. RAM: [address] and [address], bytes of the stock DIN NRPN parser (unreachable since n°9a), used by neither n°9a nor n°22, .bss. Code at 0x9d07d400-0x9d07d5ef (free flash, all 0xFF in 1.5.0.2).
